label.vi: Ảnh phủ toàn màn hình + zoom

description: A picture over the whole frame while the voice keeps going (e.g. a wall of the creator's past videos), the camera zooming towards `focus`. Optional colour tint (e.g. red for 'bad numbers') and a badge in the middle (e.g. a view count with an eye icon). Stamps and captions stay on top.

focus.doc: point to zoom towards as [x, y] fractions of the picture; it moves to the centre as far as the edges allow

tint.doc: colour laid over the picture, e.g. #B3121B; empty = none

badge.doc: short text in a rounded box in the middle, e.g. 218
